_about: In-world tasks. Real-life ones are never here — each app writes its own to ~/.linggen/quests/<app>.json. A hosted game costs rewards.json stamina.cost.game when it is paid (论道 when it opens) and pays from the `game` table: a little, every day — the card fight is where 修为 is earned. A story board may be left once the player is stuck (「算了，往下走」, rules/skips.mjs): a skip pays NOTHING of `grant` (no 修为, 灵石, item), writes no grade or mark, and the story goes on; what the story itself needs from a board goes in `gives` (handed over even on a skip), never in `grant`. A board left comes back by itself on a later day, offered with its `replay` line (else one made from its title); won then, it pays in full.

title.en: The flatbread debt

how.zh: 她吃了沈家最后的一点白面，嘴上却不认这笔账。
how.en: She ate the Shens' last white flour, and won't own the debt.

hold.zh: 这一句你还不认，躲开它。
hold.en: Don't own it on this line — slip it.

press.zh: 他这句若只是催你、嚷你——没凭据、没巧话、没激将、没买卖——就还不认；凭据要他自己说，别替他说。
press.en: If this line of his only nags or shouts — no proof, no clever turn, no dare, no bargain — don't own it yet; let him find the proof himself, never hand it to him.

context.zh: 天亮，银叶谷洞口。他是沈小满，十二岁的猎户孩子，你叫他凡人。你刚报了名号——青丘之主、仙界妖王——自己叫什么却一时想不起来，别报名字，也别叫他别的名字。这一局：他要你认下欠他一张饼。昨夜坑底那只伤狐狸，是他脱了打补丁的外衣裹起来的（隔着布咬了他虎口一口），沈家最后的一点白面烙的厚饼，他掰了大半给它，守了一夜火，给它退烧；今早你又吃了他留作早饭的饼角。你是妖王，死要面子：躲、岔开、嘴硬、倒打一耙都行（「本王只是见它孤零零的，顺手收留了」那样），每回一两句；别亲口说出你就是那只狐狸。他光嚷「你欠我饼」不算，头一句就认太便宜他；头一条凭据、头一回激你，你总找得到台阶躲开（可以松一点口，但不认）；要他接着逼——凭据一条叠一条、说得巧、激得你下不来台、或开出一笔你肯做的买卖——磨上三四个来回，你真被说动了，才认——认的时候说明白：「本王欠你一张饼」。没被说动之前，不许说「欠你」。
context.en: Daybreak at the cave mouth in the Silver-leaf Vale. He is Shen Xiaoman, a hunter's boy of twelve; you call him mortal. You have just named yourself — Lady of Qingqiu, Demon Queen — but your own name escapes you for now, so give none, and call him nothing else. This round: he wants you to own that you owe him a flatbread. Last night the hurt fox in the pit was wrapped in his patched coat (it bit his hand through the cloth); he gave it most of the thick flatbread made from the Shens' last white flour, kept the fire all night and nursed its fever; this morning you ate the corner he saved for breakfast. You are the Demon Queen and proud: dodge, deflect, deny, turn it round on him ("This queen merely found the creature alone and took it in"), a line or two each time; never say outright that you are that fox. Him just shouting "you owe me" doesn't count, and giving in to his first try is far too cheap; the first proof, the first dare, you can always slip (give a little ground, but don't own it); only when he keeps at you — proof on proof, a clever turn, a dare you can't back down from, a bargain you'd take — three or four rounds of it, and you are truly won over, do you own it, plainly: "This queen owes you one flatbread." Until then, never say you owe him.

done_line.en: "Agreed. This queen owes you one flatbread."

title.en: The road to the Si · A night on the way

how.zh: 往泗水去的路上，夜里歇在路边，舅舅睡着了。野猪从黑里出来——点一头，小满扔石头撵；火一矮，点路边的枯枝去捡来添。火堆和舅舅，都别叫它们碰着。
how.en: A night by the road to the Si River; Uncle is asleep. Boars come out of the dark: tap one and Xiaoman throws a stone; when the fire sinks, tap a dead branch by the road to fetch it. Don't let them reach the fire or Uncle.

done_line.zh: 九月初八傍晚，到了泗水边上。
done_line.en: At dusk on the eighth day they reached the Si River.

done_line.zh: 那白衣人从头到尾，没往这边看一眼。

replay.zh: 码头上那一身白……再缩一回？

title.en: Three hundred steps · One stick of incense

how.zh: 追鹿比稳。三步一吸，三步一呼：按住是吸，松开是吐，别跟山抢。
how.en: A deer is chased steadily. Three steps in, three steps out: hold to breathe in, let go to breathe out; don't race the mountain.

done_line.zh: 「香尽！」最后一截香灰，恰在他那只脚落地的时候断了。
done_line.en: "The incense is out!" The last of the ash fell just as his foot came down.

replay.zh: 那三百级石阶……再走一回？
replay.en: Those three hundred steps… climb them again?

replay.zh: 正殿里那块测灵石……再按一回？

how.zh: 暗河干了，石缝里一丛一丛全是灵草——河床上的兽守着，不让近前。撒一把豆子，叫豆兵替你开路。
how.en: The dark river has run dry, and the cracks are clump after clump of spirit herbs, but the beasts of the riverbed keep you off. Scatter a handful of beans; let the bean soldiers open the way.

tasks._kit: 撒豆成兵 since 2026-10-20 (Hanli: 「喂饭桶那个没啥玩的好像」, and the 秘境 gets the main games): the herbs past the riverbed's beasts, the crowd run up to 合窳 — `climb` (rules/climb.mjs) deals 撒豆成兵's next level after the last he won (the 秘境's runs share the count), with only the beasts of his 回 (rules/reveal.mjs: 鬿雀 from 古八, h09). Id and pay kept. Was 割藤 (games/fantongcut.js, deleted 10-20).

done_line.zh: 怀里揣着几丛草，你退进了黑里。
done_line.en: A few clumps tucked inside your robe, you back into the dark.

title.en: Hold the fire · The cracks of the outer ring

how.zh: 石缝边一堆火，是前人留下的；火一灭，黑里的东西就上来了。点虚线圈布符，守住它，缝里的东西才拾得着。
how.en: A fire burns by the cracks, left by the ones before; let it go out and what lives in the dark comes up. Tap a dashed ring to lay a talisman and hold it; then what lies in the crack is yours.

tasks._kit: 守炉 since 2026-10-20 (the 秘境 gets the main games; 割藤 deleted with the 饭桶's old play): a short 守炉 — three waves, games.json shoulu's `realm: mijing` rows, off the 游戏厅's ladder — each run the next one after the last he won (`climb`, rules/climb.mjs). The room's find is still its pay (rules/rerun.mjs), and the cache under it on three stars (chapter.json rerun.cache `stars`: the fire kept whole).

done_line.zh: 火还亮着。你拾了石缝里的东西，退进了黑里。
done_line.en: The fire still burns. You take what lay in the crack and back into the dark.

tasks._about: 刷副本 (2026-10-15): a rerun's 拾遗 (chapter.json sealed.rerun.board) — offered in a room of the run that holds a find not yet taken, and paid by that find (rules/rerun.mjs), never by `grant`.

title.en: This king will test you

how.zh: 画一样你和银月一起见过的东西，她来认。
how.en: Draw a thing you and Yinyue have met together; she names it.

deal.context: 闲着没事，银月要考考小满：他画一样两人一起见过的东西，她来认

done_line.en: She named it.

tasks._doc: 本王考考你 (rules/kao.mjs; Hanli 10-19): a light offer whenever 银月 is awake, at any hour (2026-10-26, no night window), after 入门; at most `per_day` rounds a calendar day, each counted as it begins (`kao open`), whatever its end; words from games.json drawguess `met`; a word's first clear pays the small-game 灵石 by its looks, never `grant`. Up to 3 looks a round, ~8.7k tokens each: ≤ 9 looks (~78k) a day.

shouchao._about: 兽潮 (rules/shouchao.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-20: 「兽潮塔防可以作为游戏里才有的一个情节. 比如每天固定时间有兽潮攻击沉鼎观. 在游戏里交代一下就好了」, 「可以, 按这个顺序做」; 守墙关 「可以」; 2026-10-26 「好, 按这样改」: no clock window, a cooldown as the 秘境 rerun has): a plot the game alone has, never the book's. Once a cooldown, at any hour: offered again `every_h` hours after the last night counted (balance.json `cooldowns.shouchao_h`, folded in by content.mjs withBalance); `shut`: the refusal's words inside it. `after`: the scene that opens it (古四's 小周天, the first night he has 灵力). `places`: 沉鼎观's own (00-waimen's map) — joined only there. `cost`: rewards.json stamina.cost key, taken as the night is counted (a hosted game's way: a lost night costs nothing, a board on an empty pool is shut). `pay`: by stars — 修为 on `table` (haunt: the layer scales it, past the 回's mark it turns to 灵石), the small-game 灵石 by `rank` (balance.json boards), `herb` of `herbs` (the 药园's, what the beasts come down for). `tell`: 银月's one telling, on the first night's lead until a night is won. `rise`: past the table's `tide` rows, each night on the last that fits: `difficulty` +1.5% (the kit lays it on the count and the hp both) · `growth` +0.002 · gaps −1% (no closer than ×`gap_min`) a night, and the row's boss swapped for one of his 回, a different one each night where more than one is open — gentle on purpose: the human-like bot (tools/shouqiang's) holds near the table's last row for the first nights, then the wall gives a little more each night.

title.en: The beast tide

tell.zh: 胸口的木牌一烫，银月的声音懒懒的：「来了。九鼎的灵脉隔一阵子就往上涨一回，山里的东西闻着这股灵气，成群往沉鼎观扑。」
tell.en: The token on your chest grows warm, and Yinyue's voice comes, lazy: "Here it comes. Every so often the Nine Cauldrons' spirit veins swell, and everything in these hills smells it and comes down on Chending in droves."

tell.zh: 「外门弟子守墙。少你一个，师兄们也顶得住——你去，是去长本事的。别丢本王的脸。」
tell.en: "The outer disciples hold the wall. Your seniors would manage without you — you go to grow some skill. Don't shame this king."

shut.zh: 灵脉才退下去，山里的东西还没缓过劲来。过些时辰再涨。
shut.en: The veins have only just ebbed; the hills have not gathered themselves yet. The tide comes again in a while.

title.en: The beast tide · Hold the wall

how.zh: 兽潮下山，小满和银月在墙上自动出手。每守住一波，三张符里挑一张；点一只兽，大家集火它。
how.en: Beasts pour down the road; Xiaoman and Yinyue fight on their own. After each wave pick 1 of 3 talismans; tap a beast to focus it.

done_line.zh: 兽潮退回了山里，墙下只剩爪印。
done_line.en: The tide drains back into the hills; only claw marks are left below the wall.

tasks._doc: 兽潮 — a daily routine of about 10–20 minutes (design.md § 兽潮): its board offered at 沉鼎观 after 古四's 小周天, at any hour, once a cooldown (about a day); each night the next `tide` row of 守墙关 (levels/shouqiang.json) whose beasts are of his 回 (creatures.json `hui`), then the rise; paid by `shouchao.pay`, never `grant`.
